title: Semantius Copilot agent configuration (agent.jsonc)
description: Per-agent config in agents/<name>/agent.jsonc. The file is REQUIRED: folders without it are skipped by the bundler. Skills live in agents/<name>/skills/<skill>/; an optional INSTRUCTIONS.md next to the config is appended to `instructions`. This schema mirrors validateAgentConfig in core/src/agent.js — change both together.

instructions.description: Agent instructions. An optional INSTRUCTIONS.md in the same folder is appended after this text. At least one of the two must yield non-empty instructions.

model.description: Model specifier. If the first path segment is a known provider (openrouter, custom, cloudflare) the value is used as-is; otherwise 'openrouter/' is prepended (e.g. 'deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash' -> 'openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash'). Omit to use the backend's env-derived default (LLM_PROVIDER/LLM_MODEL).

model_base_url.description: Overrides the provider base URL for this agent (an OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Auth still uses the backend's LLM_API_KEY secret.

max_tokens.description: Output-token cap for this agent's model, winning over catalog metadata. For models no catalog knows (custom endpoints, models newer than the pinned pi-ai catalog): a catalog miss otherwise runs on a conservative placeholder whose 8192-token cap truncates long single-pass responses. Dated slugs of catalog models (e.g. '-0731') do NOT need this — their metadata resolves via the undated base entry.

context_window.description: Context-window size (tokens) for this agent's model, winning over catalog metadata. Governs the compaction threshold and the output-budget clamp; the catalog-miss placeholder is 128000. Only useful together with models no catalog knows — see max_tokens.

openrouter_routing.description: OpenRouter provider-routing preferences for this agent's model calls, forwarded VERBATIM as the request-body `provider` object (https://openrouter.ai/docs/features/provider-routing) — every model turn AND the session-title side call. Any field OpenRouter accepts works; the well-known ones are listed for editor completion, unknown ones pass through unchecked (OpenRouter rejects what it doesn't understand, visible as the turn's error). Ignored for the `cloudflare` provider (AI binding, no HTTP request body). Serialized size ≤ 4096 bytes. NOTE: setting `sort` or `order` disables OpenRouter's default price-based load balancing.

sort.description: Ranking strategy: "price" (= the :floor shortcut), "throughput" (= the :nitro shortcut), "latency"; or an object { by, partition } where partition is "model" (default) or "none".

order.description: Provider slugs to try in sequence (a suffixed slug like "google-vertex/us-east5" pins one endpoint).

only.description: Allow-list of provider slugs — nothing outside it is used.

allow_fallbacks.description: Default true. With `order`: false = fail when the listed providers are unavailable instead of falling through to others.

require_parameters.description: Default false. Only route to providers that support every parameter of the request (tools, reasoning, usage accounting…).

data_collection.description: Default "allow". "deny" skips providers that may store or train on prompts.

zdr.description: Restrict routing to Zero-Data-Retention endpoints only.

enforce_distillable_text.description: Only models/hosts whose terms allow distillation of the output.

quantizations.description: Filter hosts by weight precision (open-weight models).

max_price.description: Price ceilings in USD per MILLION tokens, per direction: `prompt` (input) and `completion` (output) are independent limits; `request`, `image`, `audio` are per-unit ceilings. Typically combined with sort: "throughput" — fastest provider under the ceiling.

preferred_min_throughput.description: Soft floor in tokens/second — a number applies to p50, or an object with percentile cutoffs. Prefers, does not guarantee.

preferred_max_latency.description: Soft ceiling in seconds — a number applies to p50, or an object with percentile cutoffs. Prefers, does not guarantee.

proxy_whitelist.description: Egress allow list for this agent's sandbox. Each entry is a hostname ('www.semantius.com') or a URL ('https://api.acme.io/v1/*'), and may carry one or more '*' at any position — '*.semantius.ai' matches subdomains but not the bare apex; a bare '*' matches everything. Entries WITHOUT a path match the request's hostname only (port ignored); entries with a scheme and/or path match the request URL, and their paths are case-sensitive. This list is UNIONED at egress with the organization's own copilot allow list, so the effective policy can be wider than what stands here. DENY-ALL WHEN BOTH ARE ABSENT: an agent without this property (or with an empty list) whose org contributes nothing can make no outbound requests from its sandbox at all.

welcome.description: Welcome card the chat UI shows while a conversation is empty: title/subtitle plus sections of clickable starter prompts. UI-only — never reaches the model. Clicking a prompt sends `prompt ?? display` as the user's message, immediately unless prefill is true (then it only fills the composer), and shows its `hint` (when set) as a dismissible tip above the composer. Section/prompt counts are unbounded; only string lengths are capped.

display.description: The label shown on the prompt card.

prompt.description: Optional fuller text actually sent (or prefilled) instead of the display label.

prefill.description: true = clicking only puts the text into the composer for editing; absent/false = clicking sends it immediately.

hint.description: Optional tip shown in a dismissible box above the chat composer when this prompt is clicked. UI-only, never reaches the model. Dismissal is remembered per agent + display in the user's browser, so re-wording a display re-shows its tip once.
